parameters.name: Weight Scaling Exponent (Demo)
parameters.description: [DEMO ONLY - NOT SCIENTIFICALLY VERIFIED] Scaling power for body mass in demo calculation.

parameters.name: Height Power Exponent (Demo)
parameters.description: [DEMO ONLY - NOT SCIENTIFICALLY VERIFIED] Geometric dimensional power for height.

parameters.name: Baseline Metabolic Coefficient (Demo)
parameters.description: [DEMO ONLY - NOT SCIENTIFICALLY VERIFIED] Additive constant for demo energy model.

parameters.name: Mifflin-St Jeor Sex-Specific Energy Offset
parameters.description: Sex-specific constant in the Mifflin-St Jeor basal metabolic rate equation (+5 kcal/day for males, -161 kcal/day for females).

formulas.name: Demo Anthropometric Ratio Formula
formulas.description: [DEMO ONLY - NOT SCIENTIFICALLY VERIFIED] Illustrative formula computing weight / (height ^ height_exponent).
assumptions: Normohydrated state in demo test cohort
limitations: Does not differentiate lean vs adipose tissue

formulas.name: Demo Energy Approximation Formula
formulas.description: [DEMO ONLY - NOT SCIENTIFICALLY VERIFIED] Demonstrates multi-term additive expression with parameter offset: Base + (10 * Weight) + (6.25 * Height_cm) - (5 * Age).
limitations: Crude demographic model for platform testing only

formulas.name: Indeks Massa Tubuh (BMI / Body Mass Index - Quetelet)
formulas.description: Standar antropometri WHO untuk klasifikasi status gizi berdasarkan rasio Berat Badan (kg) terhadap kuadrat Tinggi Badan (m^2): Weight / (Height ^ 2).
limitations: Tidak membedakan proporsi massa otot (FFM) vs adiposa

formulas.name: Laju Metabolisme Basal (BMR - Mifflin-St Jeor)
formulas.description: Standar emas klinis estimasi pengeluaran energi basal (BMR/REE): (10 * Berat_kg) + (625 * Tinggi_m) - (5 * Usia) + Sex_Offset (+5 Pria / -161 Wanita).
limitations: Sensitivitas berkurang pada atlet dengan massa otot ekstrim

formulas.name: Tekanan Arteri Rata-rata (MAP - Mean Arterial Pressure)
formulas.description: Tekanan perfusi organ vaskular rata-rata dalam satu siklus jantung: DBP + (SBP - DBP) / 3.
limitations: Perkiraan berkurang akurasinya pada takikardia berat (>120 bpm)

thresholds.label: Underweight
thresholds.description: Indeks massa tubuh di bawah ambang batas fisiologis normal; risiko defisiensi makronutrien dan penurunan imunitas.

thresholds.label: Normal weight
thresholds.description: Rentang berat badan optimal dengan risiko mortalitas dan morbiditas kardiometabolik terendah.

thresholds.label: Overweight
thresholds.description: Peningkatan akumulasi adiposa pra-obesitas; indikasi peningkatan resistensi insulin dan beban biomekanik.

thresholds.label: Obesity Class I
thresholds.description: Akumulasi jaringan adiposa patologis sedang; peningkatan risiko aterosklerosis dan sindrom metabolik.

thresholds.label: Obesity Class II/III
thresholds.description: Obesitas klinis tingkat lanjut; risiko tinggi komorbiditas kardiometabolik, kardiovaskular, dan apnea tidur obstruktif.

interpretation_rules.name: Kriteria Perfusi Hemodinamik Tekanan Arteri Rata-rata (MAP)
interpretation_rules.description: Evaluasi kecukupan tekanan perfusi koroner dan mikrosirkulasi organ vital sistemik (Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology).

thresholds.label: Low Perfusion
thresholds.description: Tekanan perfusi organ kritis (terutama ginjal dan serebral) berisiko terganggu jika MAP bertahan di bawah 65 mmHg.

thresholds.label: Adequate Perfusion
thresholds.description: Gradien perfusi arteri sistemik berada dalam rentang hemodinamika fisiologis optimal.

thresholds.label: Elevated Perfusion Load
thresholds.description: Beban afterload ventrikel kiri dan resistensi perifer sistemik meningkat; indikasi hipertensi vaskular.

notebook_cells.title: Project Hypothesis & Literature Context
notebook_cells.content:
### 1. Research Objectives
This notebook evaluates the mathematical sensitivity of the **Demo Anthropometric Ratio Formula** under varying power exponents.
We evaluate whether calibrating `PARAM_DEMO_HEIGHT_EXPONENT` from 2.0 to 1.8 improves correlation with measured bioenergetic expenditure.
